_comment: Registry read by pr-digest. login: regex on the account's login. noise: regexes on the comment body; a Bot comment matching both is status chrome and never blocks green. Anchor body patterns with \A (not ^, which matches at every line start). Actionable bot comments (real findings) must NOT be listed. Override this file with PR_DIGEST_BOTS=/path/to/bots.json.

bots.name: coderabbit
noise: \A(<!-- coderabbit-ai-generated:v1 -->\s*)?<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: (summarize|rate limited) by coderabbit\.ai -->

bots.name: qodo
noise: \A\s*\[Code review\]\([^)]*\) by qodo was updated up to the latest commit
